scope: P6 channel-message reaction inbox delivery foundation
implemented: New reactions to another user's channel message create an inbox notification only when recipient preferences allow delivery and the author still has channel read access.
Removed reactions and self reactions do not notify. Matching actor/message/payload rows are deduplicated in the database across repository instances.
Notifications include actor enrichment and database creation time before websocket delivery.
Stable reaction identity uses a database primary key and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, including when display wording changes.
Inbox reaction text uses Turkish/English translations and opens the originating channel message.

All mode includes server channels; limited mode includes private conversations. One-to-one DM reactions use this shared preference and persistent delivery path, exclude pending requests and blocked pairs, and open the DM from the inbox.
Group DM reactions share delivery preferences and persistent deduplication; removed reactions, blocked pairs and departed authors do not notify. Group origin is preserved for inbox navigation.
Audible and desktop reaction cues run only on fresh persistent notification delivery; raw reaction updates no longer create false message-unread counts or repeated sounds.
remaining: Verify concurrent deduplication on every supported database backend.
Verify localized inbox and desktop presentation with two real clients.
acceptance: Implemented but unverified; real two-client acceptance and PostgreSQL concurrency evidence remain outstanding.
